description:
[payment] A 24-hour Pro API key for ONE x402 USDC payment of $1.00 (Base or Arbitrum), no email
    or account: liquidation maps and heatmaps at full resolution without the hourly cap, plus 400 units

    X-PAYMENT (v1) header and the answer carries api_key and its expiry. The same wallet extends the
    same key. This tool itself moves no money.
